name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-faithful-bonus-room-switch-palace
title: Super Mario World Styled Faithful Bonus Room / Switch Palace
description:
This is an updated version of an old Bonus Room tileset I had made. Now it's even more versatile and consistent to the SMW artstyle! It features striped and solid blocks in various colors as well as a wooden floor.

This one is compatible with the big switches and the blocks that replace the used blocks in bonus rooms, if you are into that sorta thing.
